title: Ang 1426–1429: the ninth Guru's saloks
hook: fifty-seven saloks of the passing world and the Name that remains
tomorrow: the Granth closes on a plate holding three things. what are they?

segments.voice: Yesterday, on ang 1410, the extra saloks: come to love's lane with your head on your palm. Today the ninth Guru gets the last saloks before the seal.

Notifications, plans, a stressful week: give it a month and most of it will be gone from memory. Guru Tegh Bahadur, the ninth Guru, keeps saying so in his saloks, starting on ang 1426. In paraphrase: know this world as a dream, a passing show. And near the end of the set comes the answer to yesterday's question. In paraphrase: the Name remains, the holy remain, the Guru remains.
screen: `GONE IN A MONTH.` → `A DREAM, A PASSING SHOW.` → `THE NAME REMAINS.`

segments.voice: The saloks are short couplets, plain and steady, and they keep returning to one thing: everything you can see is passing. Not to frighten anyone. A worry fades, a plan changes, even a house changes hands, and the saloks name that honestly, without drama. One salok, in paraphrase, says it outright: the wise one frightens no one, and fears no one. And the close of the set holds up what doesn't pass. The Name remains. The holy remain. The Guru remains. It gathers the week. Farid's collar, and his heart like a jewel. Guru Arjan's praise, and the Bhatts' one light. Waheguru, said in wonder before the results. Guru Nanak's love, with the head on the palm. Each one points at something that doesn't wash away with the month. The ninth Guru's saloks say it plainly, and the walk through the Granth is almost home.
screen: `EVERYTHING YOU CAN SEE PASSES.` · `FRIGHTEN NO ONE, FEAR NO ONE.` · `THE WEEK, GATHERED.` · then, large: `THE NAME REMAINS.`

segments.voice: Close your eyes and let the week's noise go by like traffic: the plans, the worries, the screens. Under it, keep one small thing steady, the breath, or the Name if you say it. Let everything else pass.
Ang 1426. Where the ninth Guru's saloks begin: the world passes like a dream, and the Name remains.
Keep this close: the name remains, when everything else on the list has passed. Back tomorrow, at the seal.

screen: `DAY 1624 COUNTS.` → `A WALK THROUGH THE GRANTH · 178 OF 180.` → `TOMORROW: A PLATE WITH THREE THINGS. WHAT ARE THEY?`
